answer: One enforceable rule: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The reef of work and the onyx of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a jade to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
